Our mission is to empower individuals of all abilities to achieve physical, emotional, and personal growth through the healing power of horses. We are dedicated to creating a safe, inclusive, and nurturing environment where participants can build confidence, enhance their well-being, and discover their full potential through equine-assisted therapy and learning. After our son, Wylde, was diagnosed with a rare disease, we searched for any possible therapy that would help him thrive. In our journey, we have come to learn the amazing benefits of equine assisted therapy. With the help from family and friends, Wylde has inspired us to create a place where we can provide equine interactions and therapy to those looking to improve their quality of life. This is an inclusive facility, meaning we serve individuals with special needs and disabilities, as well as any one wanting to learn the basics of caring and riding horses. Welcome to Wylde horsesMost people have never experienced equine assisted therapy. Heres an inside look at Wylde Horses Therapeutic Riding Facility! These are the lives we are trying to improve and the hope we provide to families. Come experience it for yourself and be apart of the magic! pages.excerpt: HomeAbout usMeet the teamThe StaffThe AnimalsThe InspirationThe SupportLessons and PricingDonateVolunteerNew Clients Contact UsMoreHomeAbout usMeet the teamThe StaffThe AnimalsThe InspirationThe SupportLessons and PricingDonateVolunteerNew Clients Contact UsHomeAbout usMeet the teamThe StaffThe AnimalsThe InspirationThe SupportLessons and PricingDonateVolunteerNew Clients Contact Us About UsOur MissionOur story began with our amazing son, Wylde, who was diagnosed with tubulinopathy. As we navigated his diagnosis, we quickly saw how powerful connection, movement, and animals, especially horses, could be in supporting his growth, regulation, and overall well-being.What started as a way to support our own child soon opened our eyes to a much greater need. We realized there were so many other individuals and families walking similar paths, seeking connection, healing, confidence, and a place where they felt truly seen and supported.Wylde Horses was created to be that place. Today, we are proud to serve individuals of all abilities, offering equine-assisted therapy and learning in a safe, inclusive, and nurturing environment. We service over 130 individuals and guide over 150 lessons a week. Each lesson being its own unique and catered experience based on needs and goals.Our mission is to empower individuals of all abilities to achieve physical, emotional, and personal growth through the healing power of horses. We are dedicated to creating a safe, inclusive, and nurturing environment where participants can build confidence, enhance their well-being, and discover their full potential through equine-assisted therapy and learning.Equine Assisted InteractionsOur Equine Groundwork Program offers a powerful, horse-centered experience without riding, allowing participants to build meaningful connections while working alongside horses on the ground. This approach is intentionally designed to support individuals who benefit from movement, structure, and interaction in a calm, controlled setting.Through guided groundwork activities, participants continue working toward therapeutic goals such as communication, balance, coordination, and confidence — and often so much more.
